purpose: Approximate image-space diagnostic for targeted repair, not canonical asset measurements or pixel-exact geometry proof.
method: Manually identified horizontal silhouette extents of upper cap and lower skirt in the actual images; approximate +/-3 pixel boundary uncertainty. No perspective calibration.
interpretation: At the intended A61-like source camera, r2 has excessive lower flare relative to its upper cap. About 10-12 percent less lower-skirt width is a starting repair guide; verify visually against original pixels rather than treating these measurements as exact dimensions.
limitations: Camera orientation/perspective, blur and source compression affect spans. A24 uses a steeper camera; no conclusion is made from total tree width/height alone. A52 corroborates the narrower relative flare qualitatively but is not assigned a numerical ratio here.
